messages.text: Buongiorno! Posso aiutarla a scegliere un cellulare?
messages.english: Good morning! Can I help you choose a smartphone?

choices.english: Yes, I would like a new smartphone.
No, I am looking for an old computer.
Yes, I want a large tablet.

messages.text: Abbiamo questo modello. Le piace lo schermo?
messages.english: We have this model. Do you like the screen?

choices.text: Sì, lo schermo è molto grande.
choices.english: Yes, the screen is very big.

choices.text: No, la tastiera è troppo piccola.
choices.english: No, the keyboard is too small.
Yes, the mouse is fast.

messages.text: Ha centoventi gigabyte di memoria. È sufficiente?
messages.english: It has one hundred twenty gigabytes of memory. Is it enough?

choices.text: Sì, la memoria è perfetta per me.
choices.english: Yes, the memory is perfect for me.
No, the battery is dead.
Yes, the volume is high.

messages.text: Il prezzo è di seicento euro. Cosa ne pensa?
messages.english: The price is six hundred euros. What do you think?

choices.text: È un buon prezzo, lo prendo.
choices.english: It is a good price, I'll take it.

choices.text: È un brutto film, non lo vedo.
choices.english: It's a bad movie, I'm not watching it.

choices.text: È un libro caro, non lo leggo.
choices.english: It's an expensive book, I'm not reading it.

messages.text: Ottima scelta! Serve anche un caricabatterie?
messages.english: Great choice! Do you also need a charger?

choices.text: Sì, mi serve un caricabatterie rapido.
choices.english: Yes, I need a fast charger.
No, I am looking for a black umbrella.
Yes, I would like a hot coffee.

messages.text: Lo vuole di colore nero o blu?
messages.english: Do you want it in black or blue?

choices.english: I prefer it black, thank you.
I want it sweet, please.
I see it broken, I'm sorry.

messages.text: La fotocamera è ottima. Le serve una scheda di memoria?
messages.english: The camera is excellent. Do you need a memory card?

choices.english: No, the internal memory is enough.
Yes, dinner is ready.
No, the train is leaving now.

messages.text: Vuole anche una custodia protettiva?
messages.english: Do you also want a protective case?

choices.english: Yes, I would like a transparent one.
No, I would like a red apple.
Yes, I am looking for a comfortable chair.

messages.text: Paga in contanti o con carta di credito?
messages.english: Are you paying in cash or with a credit card?

choices.text: Pago con la carta di credito.
choices.english: I'm paying with the credit card.
I'm eating with the fork.
I'm going by bus.

messages.text: Ecco lo scontrino. Serve una busta?
messages.english: Here is the receipt. Do you need a bag?

choices.text: No grazie, ho già una borsa.
choices.english: No thanks, I already have a bag.
Yes thanks, I am very hungry.

choices.text: No grazie, il tempo è brutto.
choices.english: No thanks, the weather is bad.

messages.text: Salve! Cerca delle cuffie per la musica?
messages.english: Hello! Are you looking for headphones for music?

choices.text: Sì, vorrei delle cuffie senza fili.
choices.english: Yes, I would like wireless headphones.
No, I want red gloves.
Yes, I am looking for new shoes.

messages.text: Queste cuffie hanno una batteria molto lunga.
messages.english: These headphones have a very long battery life.

choices.text: Ottimo, la batteria è molto importante.
choices.english: Great, the battery is very important.
Nice, the sea is calm.
Good, the pizza is hot.

messages.text: Durano trenta ore. Sono molto comode.
messages.english: They last thirty hours. They are very comfortable.

choices.english: Can I try these headphones?
Can I open this window?
Can I call a taxi?

messages.text: Certo! Il suono è molto chiaro. Le piacciono?
messages.english: Of course! The sound is very clear. Do you like them?

choices.english: Yes, the sound is fantastic.

choices.text: No, il treno è in ritardo.
choices.english: No, the train is late.
Yes, the coffee is bitter.

messages.text: Costano cento euro. Sono in promozione.
messages.english: They cost one hundred euros. They are on promotion.

choices.english: I'll take them, I like them a lot.
I wash them, they are very dirty.
I see them, they are very far.

messages.text: Preferisce il modello bianco o quello nero?
messages.english: Do you prefer the white model or the black one?

choices.english: I'll take the black model, thank you.
I'll take the eight o'clock train.
I'll take a cream gelato.

messages.text: Hanno anche la riduzione del rumore.
messages.english: They also have noise reduction.

choices.english: Perfect for traveling by plane.
Great for cooking pasta.
Good for sleeping in the garden.

messages.text: C'è anche un cavo per usarle con il filo.
messages.english: There is also a cable to use them with the wire.

choices.english: Useful if the battery runs out.
Nice if the sun rises.
Bad if the rain falls.

messages.text: Le serve un adattatore per l'aereo?
messages.english: Do you need an adapter for the plane?

choices.text: No grazie, ne ho già uno.
choices.english: No thanks, I already have one.
Yes thanks, I am very thirsty.
No thanks, I'm looking for a book.

messages.text: Vuole fare un'assicurazione contro i danni?
messages.english: Do you want to take out insurance against damage?

choices.text: No, per ora non mi serve.
choices.english: No, for now I don't need it.
Yes, for now I'm not eating.
No, for now I'm not sleeping.

messages.text: Buongiorno. Cerca un computer per lavorare?
messages.english: Good morning. Are you looking for a computer for work?

choices.english: Yes, I would like a laptop computer.
No, I want a warm coat.
Yes, I am looking for a small dog.

messages.text: Questo modello ha sedici gigabyte di memoria.
messages.english: This model has sixteen gigabytes of memory.

choices.text: Sedici gigabyte vanno bene per me.
choices.english: Sixteen gigabytes are fine for me.
Ten euros are too many.
Two cats are happy.

messages.text: La batteria dura circa dieci ore.
messages.english: The battery lasts about ten hours.

choices.text: Dieci ore sono ottime per il lavoro.
choices.english: Ten hours are great for work.

choices.text: Due ore sono poche per dormire.
choices.english: Two hours are few for sleeping.

choices.text: Tre ore sono lunghe per la cena.
choices.english: Three hours are long for dinner.

messages.text: Il computer è molto leggero e sottile.
messages.english: The computer is very light and thin.

choices.text: Perfetto, lo porto spesso in borsa.
choices.english: Perfect, I often carry it in my bag.

choices.text: Ottimo, lo mangio sempre a casa.
choices.english: Great, I always eat it at home.

choices.text: Bene, lo vedo spesso al parco.
choices.english: Good, I often see it at the park.

messages.text: Sì, costa novecento euro compresa l'IVA.
messages.english: Yes, it costs nine hundred euros including VAT.

choices.text: Lo compro, mi serve per l'ufficio.
choices.english: I'll buy it, I need it for the office.

choices.text: Lo mangio, mi serve per la cena.
choices.english: I eat it, I need it for dinner.

choices.text: Lo leggo, mi serve per lo studio.
choices.english: I read it, I need it for studying.

messages.text: Il sistema operativo è già installato.
messages.english: The operating system is already installed.

choices.english: Great, so it's ready for use.

choices.text: Bello, così è pronto per il mare.
choices.english: Nice, so it's ready for the sea.

choices.text: Male, così è pronto per la pioggia.
choices.english: Bad, so it's ready for the rain.

messages.text: Ha anche tre porte USB e una porta HDMI.
messages.english: It also has three USB ports and one HDMI port.

choices.text: Mi servono per collegare il mouse.
choices.english: I need them to connect the mouse.

choices.text: Mi servono per cucinare la carne.
choices.english: I need them to cook the meat.

choices.text: Mi servono per lavare i vestiti.
choices.english: I need them to wash the clothes.

messages.text: Vuole anche un mouse senza fili?
messages.english: Do you also want a wireless mouse?

choices.english: Yes, I would like a small one.
No, I would like a large gelato.
Yes, I'm looking for a green umbrella.

messages.text: La tastiera è retroilluminata, le piace?
messages.english: The keyboard is backlit, do you like it?

choices.text: Sì, è utile per scrivere di sera.
choices.english: Yes, it is useful for writing in the evening.

choices.text: No, è inutile per correre nel parco.
choices.english: No, it is useless for running in the park.

choices.text: Sì, è comodo per dormire a letto.
choices.english: Yes, it is comfortable for sleeping in bed.

messages.text: Possiamo preparare il pacco in dieci minuti.
messages.english: We can prepare the package in ten minutes.

choices.english: Perfect, I'll wait here in the store.

choices.text: Bene, vado a fare il bagno.
choices.english: Good, I'm going for a swim.
Great, I'm going to sleep now.

messages.text: Desidera comprare questo computer?
messages.english: Do you want to buy this computer?

choices.text: Sì, ma vorrei informazioni sulla garanzia.
choices.english: Yes, but I would like information about the warranty.

choices.text: No, ma cerco informazioni sulla pioggia.
choices.english: No, but I am looking for information about the rain.

choices.text: Sì, ma voglio informazioni sulla pizza.
choices.english: Yes, but I want information about the pizza.

messages.text: La garanzia standard è di due anni.
messages.english: The standard warranty is two years.

choices.text: Due anni sono obbligatori per legge?
choices.english: Are two years mandatory by law?

choices.text: Due anni sono troppi per un film?
choices.english: Are two years too many for a movie?

choices.text: Due ore sono lunghe per un pranzo?
choices.english: Are two hours long for a lunch?

messages.text: Sì, la batteria è coperta per un anno.
messages.english: Yes, the battery is covered for one year.

choices.english: Good, then I'll take it.
Badly, then I'll throw it away.
Maybe, then I'll look for it.

messages.text: Lo schermo ha due anni di protezione.
messages.english: The screen has two years of protection.

choices.english: Perfect, this reassures me a lot.
Great, this tires me a lot.
Good, this stops me now.

messages.text: La garanzia vale se ha lo scontrino.
messages.english: The warranty is valid if you have the receipt.

choices.text: Va bene, lo metto in un posto sicuro.
choices.english: Alright, I'll put it in a safe place.

choices.text: Vado via, lo porto al parco giochi.
choices.english: I'm leaving, I'll take it to the playground.
I'm staying here, I'll eat it immediately.

messages.text: Copre i difetti di fabbrica, non i danni accidentali.
messages.english: It covers manufacturing defects, not accidental damage.

choices.text: Capisco, quindi se cade non è coperto.
choices.english: I see, so if it falls it is not covered.

choices.text: Capisco, quindi se mangio non è buono.
choices.english: I see, so if I eat it's not good.

choices.text: Capisco, quindi se dormo non è tardi.
choices.english: I see, so if I sleep it's not late.

messages.text: Possiamo estendere la garanzia a tre anni.
messages.english: We can extend the warranty to three years.

choices.english: How much does the extension cost?
How much does the elephant weigh?
How much does the horse run?

messages.text: Costa cinquanta euro in più.
messages.english: It costs fifty euros more.

choices.english: Alright, I prefer to have it.
No thanks, I prefer pizza.
Yes, I prefer the sea.

messages.text: La garanzia è valida in tutta Italia.
messages.english: The warranty is valid throughout Italy.

choices.english: Great, even in other cities.
Bad, even in other dishes.
Good, even in other woods.

messages.text: In caso di guasto, può venire qui in negozio.
messages.english: In case of a breakdown, you can come here to the store.

choices.text: Perfetto, spero di non averne bisogno.
choices.english: Perfect, I hope I won't need it.

choices.text: Bello, spero di non mangiare tutto.
choices.english: Nice, I hope I won't eat everything.

choices.text: Bene, spero di non dormire troppo.
choices.english: Good, I hope I won't sleep too much.
